name: Treasury & Cash Management Services
description: Transaction banking for corporate clients: operating balances, liquidity products, and payment and receivables services.

dimensions.name: service
dimensions.description: Service line (ACH, wires, lockbox, liquidity, merchant)

metrics.name: operating_balances
metrics.description: Client operating deposit balances at a point in time

metrics.name: fee_revenue
metrics.description: Treasury services fee revenue in the period

metrics.name: earnings_credit_rate
metrics.description: Rate credited against service charges on analyzed accounts

conventions.rule: Earnings credit offsets fees rather than paying interest; do not mix ECR with deposit rates paid.
Operational deposits are defined by the liquidity rules; state the definition used.

caveats.text: Fee revenue can be paid in balances (soft dollars) rather than cash; hard- and soft-dollar fees are not comparable without conversion.

chart_conventions.rule: Show transaction count and value as separate panels; they move differently.

review.notes: Drafted from public, general industry conventions; not yet reviewed by a named domain owner.
